summary: Cohere evaluation/trial keys are free for testing and proofs of concept, limited to 1,000 API calls per month with Chat models at 20 requests per minute. Official pricing explicitly says trial keys are not permitted for production or commercial purposes. When an account is created, a Trial API key is automatically created and available on the dashboard/API Keys page. Production access is paid and requires the Go to Production workflow.
claim_steps: Retrieve the automatically created Trial API key from the dashboard or API Keys page.
Use it only for evaluation/testing, not production or commercial purposes; stay within 1,000 calls/month and Chat 20 RPM.
For production, an organization Owner must complete the billing/Go to Production workflow and use paid production access.

social_proof.title: Different Types of API Keys and Rate Limits | Cohere
social_proof.text: Cohere offers two kinds of API keys: evaluation keys (free but limited in usage), and production keys. Trial keys are limited to 1,000 API calls a month. Chat API trial rate limit: 20 req / min.

social_proof.title: Trial API key production and commercial-use restriction
social_proof.text: API calls made from a Trial API key are free. However, trial keys are rate limited and are not permitted to be used for production or commercial purposes.

social_proof.title: Automatically created Trial API key
social_proof.text: When an account is created, we automatically create an Trial API key for you.
